scope: Descriptive matched ARM validation; no superiority, non-inferiority or fastest-lap claim
firmware: Frozen November 13 TROPIC RT1064 simulation ELFs; controller equations unchanged
plant: Existing 2 kg, 500 mm diagonal Rumoca plant; no physical parameters changed

inputs.noise: Same seed and sample schedule, fixed-hover-reference vibration independent of actual motor outputs; retain binary innovations to verify SHA-256 equality
inputs.quantization: Match BF virtual int16 IMU: truncation, +/-32767 counts; gyro16.4LSB/deg/s; accel2048LSB/g
inputs.attitude: Same 35-degree normal-stick map; +/-0.035-degree quantization tolerance; fixed yaw=0
inputs.acro: Outside primary figure-eight qualification; historical nominal10deg/s discrepancy is preserved and not relabeled matched

tuning.requalification: Four fresh 5-degree signed roll/pitch probes per stack, realistic seed1, fresh hover per probe
tuning.action_if_failed: Retain failure; do not call inherited tuning ARM-qualified. Fixed-gain baseline comparisons remain diagnostic.

gates.course: one ordered figure-eight, full extents and center return

scoring: Post-step ground-truth vs held100Hz reference at8000Hz, t25 through lap_end inclusive; binary raw scoring samples retained for independent recalculation
failures: Retain all attempts. A timeout is an infrastructure failure, never a performance boundary.
